checks.label: Describe a time you worked directly with an external enterprise customer on an ML/AI problem.
checks.expected: I don’t want to overstate this: I have not yet owned a direct external enterprise customer engagement on an ML/AI problem. The closest analogue is my applied ML work at Arborphy AI, where I worked through an ambiguous domain problem end to end: plant identification and botanical reasoning. I designed and evaluated vision/biological embedding architectures, built disjoint benchmarks for species identification and retrieval, created a human-review set, and developed a multi-agent botanical reasoning prototype with knowledge-graph evidence aggregation. At Columbia, I also made research code usable for non-ML wet-lab researchers through packaging, documentation, and step-by-step guides. That is the customer-facing muscle I would bring to Databricks, while being clear that enterprise client ownership would be a growth area.
